body:
**Preferred gene-related syndrome label**
For example: NAA10-related syndrome
KY-related neuromyopathy

**Synonyms**

**Parent term (use [OLS](https://www.ebi.ac.uk/ols/ontologies/mondo), or your favorite ontology browser)**
MONDO:0100546 "hereditary neuromuscular disease"

**Definition**
Please write the definition in the format: Any [parent class] in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the [gene name] gene. For example: Any congenital myopathy in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the TPM3 gene.
Any neuromyopathy in which the cause of the disease is mutation in the KY gene. 

**Definition source (Please give PubMed ID, if applicable, in format PMID:#######)
The ClinGen Muscular Dystrophy and Myopathy GCEP considers the below suggested children terms to be part of a spectrum of KY-related neuromyopathy. The group is still evaluating whether the myopathy associated with this gene should be considered myofibrillar myopathy, and so additional requests related to MONDO:0014922 "myofibrillar myopathy 7" may be made in the future.
PMID:27484770, PMID:27485408, PMID:28488683, PMID:32818658

**Children terms (if applicable)** Should any existing terms be re-classified as children underneath this new proposed term? 
MONDO:0014922 "myofibrillar myopathy 7"
MONDO:0044648 "kyphoscoliosis-lateral tongue atrophy-hereditary spastic paraplegia syndrome"
MONDO:0044647 "kyphosis-lateral tongue atrophy-myofibrillar myopathy syndrome"
 
**Your nano-attribution (ORCID) or URL for a working group**
If you don't have an ORCID, you can sign up for one [here](https://orcid.org/)
https://clinicalgenome.org/affiliation/40151/
0000-0002-2078-7280

comments.body:
@clauseMDM thank you for this request. The new term, KY-related neuromyopathy, will be available in Mondo at the next release.

The three terms that you indicate will appear as children of this term. 

MONDO:0014922 "myofibrillar myopathy 7"
MONDO:0044648 "kyphoscoliosis-lateral tongue atrophy-hereditary spastic paraplegia syndrome"
MONDO:0044647 "kyphosis-lateral tongue atrophy-myofibrillar myopathy syndrome"

Please let us know if these need to be updated in the future.

title: NTR/KY
